title: Controlling Learned Effects to Reduce Spurious Correlations in Text Classifiers

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating the causal effect (Average Treatment Effect) of identity-related tokens like 'black' and 'white' on ground-truth toxicity labels using a Riesz-based doubly robust estimator to detect whether human annotators inappropriately associate these words with toxicity.
Estimating the causal feature effect of the token 'gay' on dataset toxicity labels using a Riesz representer to identify annotator bias.

Measuring the reliance of text classifiers on non-causal dataset artifacts (such as numerical ratings like '8/10' in IMDB or the word 'kill' in toxicity datasets) by evaluating overall accuracy versus minority group accuracy (samples where the spurious correlation breaks).
